analysis:
Only CHANGELOG.md text was supplied. No code or patch hunks were visible, so claims could not be verified against source. Items examined against the threat model:
- Line 394 (cache-routing persistence) and line 309 (hardware interest) add coordinator data stores. T-059 and T-041 do not cover them.
- Lines 517/518/521/524 (SSD TTL 30 min, demand-gated writes, Qwen3.5-9B default-on) are consistent with the existing T-041/SEC-035 re-acceptance. Line 435 (write budget 150 to 750 GB/day) affects disk wear and endurance only, not at-rest exposure.
- Lines 494-496 and 488 (fail-closed attestation challenges, protocol-3-only App Attest, MIN_PROVIDER_VERSION floor) are hardening consistent with T-036/T-052..T-058. They need a human to raise the live env value.
- Line 492 (removal of unauthenticated earnings lookup) matches T-031.
- Lines 282-290 (Autopilot, observe-only by default, enabling live coordinator unload commands) add a coordinator-to-provider control surface. A future pass should check authorization and session binding of those commands (TB-002).
- Line 593 (`darkbloom report` under sudo reading invoking user's credentials and uploading diagnostics) is a privacy surface worth a code check.
- Lines 449-451 (automatic model artifact revisions with R2 fallback) bear on A-004/T-012/T-027 and need manifest and integrity checks reviewed in code.
- Lines 260-262 (payout migration) bear on TB-008 and need atomic-settlement review.
No code-level conclusions are possible.

findings.detail: The changelog describes a write-behind Postgres copy of SSD cache holders and observed demand that survives coordinator restarts. T-041 only covers provider-side at-rest artifacts and in-memory routing scope. T-059 does not mention this new store. The rows carry account-derived scope HMACs, model builds, prefix-length and timing data, so they may expose which accounts reused prefixes after a database compromise or admin export. They may also survive account erasure. Fix: add this store to T-041/T-059. Confirm it contains no raw prompts, chain hashes or account IDs. Include it in the account-erasure inventory. Test that rows are purged on erasure and that the cache-key generation can rotate.
findings.title: Persisted cache-routing holders and demand add an account-scoped store not covered by the threat model

findings.detail: The changelog adds durable Earn-page notification interest stored per authenticated account, plus a bounded admin-only export joined to current email. This is a new PII-linked table and export path. T-059 does not list it among the data an account erasure must remove, and TB-006 does not list the export among admin-surface exports. An erased account could leave its email-linked interest rows behind or still appear in exports. Fix: add the table and export to T-059 and TB-006. Delete or anonymize rows on erasure. Add a regression test and audit logging for the export.
findings.title: New per-account hardware-interest table with admin email export is outside the erasure and admin-export model
